Input: `fromJSON(toJSON(state), config)` through a JSON string round trip. Result: toJSON writes the doc as `sliceDoc()`, the lines joined with the state's lineBreak (state.ts:207), and fromJSON splits that string again like `create` does, on the configured lineSeparator or `/
?|
/` (state.ts:233-234, :246); anchors and heads come back as written, while cursor assoc, bidiLevel and goal column are reset (assoc 0, null, none). The same lines come back when every line is free of the separator fromJSON splits on: a doc split from a string with the default split (F0142, F1309, F2015: "a
bc" gives lines a, b, c both ways) or with the same lineSeparator on both sides (F2092: lines "a
b", "c" kept under "
"). A line that holds such a separator, possible when the doc was given as a `Text` (Text.of stores lines as given), is split again: Text.of(["ab", "c"]) and Text.of(["a
b", "c"]) come back as lines a, b, c with the length unchanged (F2016, F2091); Text.of(["a
b", "c"]) under lineSeparator "
" comes back as lines a, b, c with the length 6 -> 5 (F2093), and a cursor at the old end 6 makes fromJSON throw RangeError("Selection points outside of document") (F2094).
cm6: mirrors/cm6/state/src/state.ts:205-209 (EditorState.toJSON), mirrors/cm6/state/src/state.ts:222-237 (EditorState.fromJSON), mirrors/cm6/state/src/state.ts:246 (EditorState.create split); mirrors/cm6/state/src/selection.ts:102-106 (SelectionRange.fromJSON uses EditorSelection.range)
hazards: Lossy round trip of selection flags

mirrors/cm6/state/src/state.ts:207, :246 the round trip re-splits the string form: lines holding the split separator (a Text given directly, mirrors/cm6/state/src/text.ts:153-157) are not restored, and the length can change (F2093, F2094)
